A '''transit visa''' was one of several documents that citizens of [[Pembric II]] needed to have in order to leave the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] after strict emigration laws were enacted by local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Crev Bombaasa/Legends|Crev Bombaasa]] and his [[Pembric II government|puppet government]]. They were expensive to buy.
